# ssp_upgrade_coordinator_config (Resource)

Manages the pre-upgrade configuration of the **Upgrade Coordinator**: the SSP version to upgrade to.

The Upgrade Coordinator cannot be deployed until a target version is set, so apply this resource before `ssp_upgrade` and order them with `depends_on = [ssp_upgrade_coordinator_config.<name>]`. Valid target versions are listed by the `ssp_upgrade_available_versions` data source.

The backend only accepts a change while the Upgrade Coordinator is **not** deployed ("upgrade coordinator is already deployed" otherwise). `ssp_upgrade` deploys it on create and undeploys it on destroy, so set the version before creating `ssp_upgrade`, and destroy `ssp_upgrade` before changing it.

This is a singleton resource — use `terraform import ssp_upgrade_coordinator_config.this singleton` to adopt an existing configuration. There is no delete API, so `Delete` only removes the resource from Terraform state and the configuration stays on the cluster.

Corresponds to `GET/PUT /ssp/lcm/upgrade-coordinator/config` and `GET /ssp/lcm/upgrade-coordinator/config/status`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `target_version` (String) SSP version to upgrade to, for example `5.2.2-0.0-105352618`. Must be one of the versions returned by `ssp_upgrade_available_versions`.

### Read-Only

- `config_message` (String) Informational message accompanying `config_status`.
- `config_status` (String) Configuration status from the platform, for example `DEPLOYMENT_REQUIRED` or `CONFIGURATION_APPLIED`.
- `id` (String) Always `singleton` for this resource.
- `revision` (Number) Revision number maintained by the SSP backend.
